proposed_statement:
An unbalanced GF3 matroid circuit of integer columns with equal nonzero integer column sum is rationally independent. Its selected Gram determinant is a positive multiple of nine, with no further factor of three forced.
For every explicitly defined17-point/twelve-triangle choice of ell,r,sigma,rho, the12 selected rows ell,r,all four free points,a1,a3,b1,b3,x,s have incidence determinant plus or minus3. The17x12 matrix has rational rank12, ternary rank11, one unbalanced circuit with5 positive and7 negative coefficients, and rectangular Smith factors1 repeated11 times and3 once.
The global modulo-nine nonlifting condition cannot reject the defined fixed17 unbalanced circuit family by treating nonlifting as a contradiction, assuming support-preserving integer lifts, or transferring full-row-rank zero-left-radical to the partial17x12 incidence.
